title: Turkmen–Turkish–English parallel sentence records
description: Top-level array of aligned sentence records. Every record has a Turkmen sentence and at least one Turkish or English translation. Cross-file rules (source references, duplicate text, alignment heuristics, canonical ordering) are enforced by go run ./tools/parallelcorpus.

id.description: Stable record identifier; never renumber or reuse an identifier.

translations.description: Aligned sentences keyed by ISO 639-1 language code: tk (Turkmen), tr (Turkish), en (English).

verification_status.description: unverified: not checked by a human translator (all machine-generated or AI-assisted text starts here). human_reviewed: every translation in the record was checked against the Turkmen sentence by a fluent human reviewer.

source.description: Identifier of the provenance record in sources.json. Never null: every sentence must have documented provenance and redistribution permission.
